newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - S. Barney starts Regency.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - S. Barney starts Regency.

text.p: -- Smith Barney initiated coverage of Regency Realty Corp as outperform, a Smith Barney source said.
-- Additional details were not immediately available.
-- Regency gained 1/8 to 25-1/8 in early morning trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
-- Smith Barney analyst William Acheson set a 12-month price target of $27.50 a share.
-- Acheson said in a report he expects Regency to earn $0.52 a share in the fourth quarter and $2.01 a share for the full year 1996. He sees the company earning $2.14 a share in 1997.
-- Regency's property portfolio, which includes grocery and drug store-anchored shopping centers, offers above-average security and stability compared with other REITs, Acheson said.
